description: This file contains functions and data structures for rendering unsupported browser pages in the Mattermost web application, including browser detection, download links, and app installation prompts.

classes.name: MattermostApp
classes.description: Represents download information for the Mattermost application for different OS platforms.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Represents a browser with download and support information.

classes.name: SystemBrowser
classes.description: Represents a system browser with links to open or set as default.

methods.name: renderUnsupportedBrowser
methods.description: Main function to generate data for the unsupported browser page, including user agent detection and conditional content.

methods.name: renderMattermostAppMac
methods.description: Returns download info for the Mattermost app on MacOS.

methods.name: renderMattermostAppWindows
methods.description: Returns download info for the Mattermost app on Windows.

methods.name: renderBrowserChrome
methods.description: Returns download info for Chrome browser.

methods.name: renderBrowserFirefox
methods.description: Returns download info for Firefox browser.

methods.name: renderBrowserSafari
methods.description: Returns download info for Safari browser.

methods.name: renderSystemBrowserEdge
methods.description: Returns info for opening or setting Edge as default system browser.
